purpose: Normative installed payload aliases and exact case exceptions for fresh Linux installations. Source names are logical input slots, not a requirement to create an uppercase staging tree. Source repository and standalone upstream names remain unchanged. This map plus component build instructions does not claim exact reproduction of a private test ZIP or a final build from empty dependencies.

assembly_inputs.programs: Build the six unchanged CMake target IDs in outputs; use their actual lowercase output filenames. Rebuild dependency instructions are in BUILDING.txt.
assembly_inputs.Docs/ThirdParty/*: distribution/ThirdParty/manifest.json; use distribution/linux/THIRD_PARTY.txt for the Linux summary
assembly_inputs.Bin/tzdata/*: third_party/tzdata/2026f/data/*; preserve exact IANA relative names
assembly_inputs.Bin/ClamAV/*: Use the qualified ClamAV version and original source/license inputs described by distribution/linux/THIRD_PARTY.txt; preserve required upstream relative names.
assembly_inputs.Doors/* and Docs/Doors/*: Matching standalone component sources/instructions/notices are retained in FullSource ComponentSource and DoorSource; build programs from those sources and retain required runtime-relative assets. Apply only the exact listed installed aliases and the two admitted integration guide overrides.
assembly_inputs.config/linux-layout.v1: distribution/linux/linux-layout.v1; exact marker, fresh-only policy, no other configuration seed

rules: All SFX-owned installed target components are lowercase ASCII. Only exact rows with a case_exception retain required vendor, IANA or game-relative spelling.
The owner-selected installation prefix, external configured paths, arbitrary owner files and required DOS names are not renamed.
Canonical archive member names stay unchanged; the runtime PhysicalLayout mapping in the corresponding source maps them to the fresh native layout.

The installer package-manifest format is 1, platform linux-amd64, current version, and top-level layout_schema linux-lowercase-v1. Every actual file row binds target path, byte size, SHA-256, mode and always/fresh policy. Compute those values from the current qualified bytes; stale compiled sizes/hashes are not normative map data.

Include the current distribution/linux/install.py and legacy-docs-rc12.json beside package-manifest.json and payload/. Fresh payload contains the exact schema marker; existing unknown/uppercase installations are not automatically migrated.

owned_lazy_leaves.temporary caller lock: node/<number>/sfxdoor.lck (or the exact selected startup/temporary drop directory)

runtime_boundaries: Lowercase only filesystem components owned/generated by SFX. Original IDs, canonical journal/archive namespaces and receive/publication wire records remain unchanged.
Marker is the exact portable linux-lowercase-v1 schema, not an installation ID. Old/mixed/unmarked established state refuses; no migration is offered.
Arbitrary owner paths, file payload basenames, existing artwork, required game/DOS names, qualified IANA and upstream ClamAV notice islands retain exact spelling.
FTN profile temp remains ftn/external/temp; its directory structure is unchanged.
required_case_precision: The SFX-generated boot batch is not a required-case game/protocol filename and is lowercase. Required game/drop/wire/QWK/REP/control/content names remain unchanged; no arbitrary data basename normalization.
